user.title: Connect to Pieria
user.description: Enter the address of your Pieria server.

discovery_confirm.title: Pieria found
discovery_confirm.description: Set up the Pieria server at {host}?

token.title: API token
token.description: Paste an API token for {host}. Create one in Pieria under Settings, API & Integrations, with both the read and control scopes.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Pieria
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {host} was rejected. Paste a new one (read and control scopes).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Pieria server.
error.missing_scope: The token is missing a scope. Create a new token with both read and control.

abort.already_configured: This Pieria server is already configured.
abort.wrong_server: That token belongs to a different Pieria server.

show_artwork.name: Show artwork
show_artwork.description: Show a specific artwork on a display now. Give an artwork ID or a search query (first hit is used).

query.name: Search query
query.description: Text search over the library; the best match is shown.

set_quiet.name: Set quiet mode
set_quiet.description: Force quiet on, force the display awake, or hand control back to the schedule (auto). on and off end at the given time or the next schedule boundary.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: on = quiet now, off = awake now, auto = follow the quiet-hours schedule.

until.name: Until
until.description: When the override ends (default: the next schedule boundary). Ignored for auto.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the override lasts from now. Use either this or Until.

not_live.message: {display} is not live (asleep or offline), so it cannot take commands right now.

unknown_playlist.message: Pieria does not know that playlist: {message}

insufficient_scope.message: The Pieria API token does not have the control scope.

auth_failed.message: The Pieria server rejected the API token.

cannot_connect.message: Could not reach the Pieria server.

artwork_id_or_query.message: Provide exactly one of artwork_id or query.

until_or_duration.message: Use either until or duration, not both.

unsupported_for_kind.message: {display} is an e-ink or frame display and does not support that action.
